brief:
Radaa, a security force affiliated with Palestinian resistance movements in Gaza, said it refrained from opening fire on an armed gang that infiltrated northeast of Nuseirat because the group was using children and women as human shields, Shehab Wire reported. The force did not specify the gang's affiliation or the circumstances of the infiltration.

The restraint reflects tactical constraints faced by armed groups operating in densely populated areas of Gaza, where civilian presence complicates engagement decisions.
